subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` slash command, fold fallback-chain testing into `openclaw models status --probe --all`, or defer the behavior to a broader staged model-migration workflow?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent command surface overlaps existing auth probes plus open model diagnostics and migration-safety requests, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make the broader configured-model health-check work own fallback-chain validation and add slash-command discoverability only if maintainers want that UX.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in staged model migration and avoid a standalone command until that broader workflow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the clearest issue guidance and has direct history on the overlapping model-status probe and fallback command surfaces.
